text: The access points is good for us, right? Because we get connected very quickly. The tap gets performed very quickly. Nice, but we should think about something else, and this is a common issue in in wireless technologies. What is the drawback of the fact that our WiFi card tries to connect to the mostly visited access points? Remember that these packets that our WiFi card send are controlled packets, right? And that the wireless medium is open. I mean, air, right? Anybody can catch the signals that are sent over a wireless channel. Unless you encrypt the data that you send, anybody can hear those data. So the problem is about privacy. Because if you are in a different environment and there is a malicious user there, you will there, you will listen to the control messages that your WiFi card transmits, and you will hear your WiFi card asking, "Are you black and white access point there?" And there is no that access point there. "Are you Polito access point there?" No, there is no Polito access point. So this.
